condition: Calling .locale() after .tz() for a zone whose offset is 0 (e.g. Europe/London) drops the timezone conversion, so format() prints the time in the local offset instead of the target zone.
workaround: Convert with tz() and format to a string first, then parse that string again and apply locale() before the final format (or set the locale globally with dayjs.locale instead of chaining it).
